detail: host/native/extent.lisp fnn-extent-lz-buffer-octet, reached through fn-durable-realize-lz-octet outside window mode (the arena scalar export, one call per octet index I), takes *fnn-extent-lock* and compares the buffer key once per octet even when the decoded block is already buffered. The D27 class PERF-REGRESSION-20261005 measured for the scalar window borrow (a lock and calls per octet, about 6 us each). Found by loop_call_check's new-site review (LOOP-CALL-BASELINE-GROWTH); accepted into the baseline in planning/repair/ACKS.md under this item. Repair: serve the scalar export from a borrowed decoded window (a span), as window mode already does, with a measurement before and after.
title: fnn-extent-lz-buffer-octet takes the extent lock once per octet of the LZ scalar export (D27 class)
